kicker.zh: 试做 · 从两块元件搭起证明器
kicker.en: Trial · A prover from two parts

lede.zh: 证明器的地基只有两块元件：套用和假设框。你用它们证出公理 K 和 S，再拿掉框，看只靠公理的证明器有多费劲，以及为什么框能换成公理。
lede.en: The prover’s foundation is two parts: Apply and the assumption box. With them you prove the axioms K and S, then take the box away to see how hard a prover with only axioms works, and why a box can always be traded for them.

Moon.en: the moon is made of cheese

desc.zh: 元件上选 A 和 B，直接给出 A → (B → A)：已经成立的事，加上什么条件都还成立。
desc.en: Choose A and B on the part; it gives A → (B → A) at once: what holds still holds under any condition.

desc.zh: 元件上选 A、B、C，直接给出 (A → (B → C)) → ((A → B) → (A → C))：在条件 A 下也能套用。
desc.en: Choose A, B and C on the part; it gives (A → (B → C)) → ((A → B) → (A → C)) at once: Apply works under a condition A too.

question.zh: 只靠套用和假设框，能搭出什么？
question.en: What can be built from Apply and the assumption box alone?

brief.zh: 已知「下雨 ∧ 刮风」和「下雨 → 地湿」，证出「地湿 ∧ 刮风」。
brief.en: Given “it rains ∧ it is windy” and “it rains → the ground is wet”, prove “the ground is wet ∧ it is windy”.

hint.zh: 先拆开 ∧，拿到「下雨」去套用；再把「地湿」和「刮风」拼起来。
hint.en: Split the ∧ first and apply the given to “it rains”; then join “the ground is wet” with “it is windy”.

t.zh: 真值电路里的「与」门：两边都真，才输出真。证明器里，「…与…」写成 ∧，照着这张表有两块元件。
t.en: The “and” gate of the truth circuits: true only when both sides are true. In the prover “… and …” is written ∧, and that table gives it two parts.

t.zh: 拼成 ∧：两边都证出来了，就有「左边 ∧ 右边」，正是表里唯一为真的那一行。拆开 ∧：有了「左边 ∧ 右边」，两边就都是真的，它有两个输出口。
t.en: Join ∧: with both sides proved, “left ∧ right”, just the one row of the table where it is true. Split ∧: from “left ∧ right” both sides are true; it has two outputs.

after.zh: 拆开、套用、拼成。两块元件都不用开框：它们只是把「与」门的真值表变成了规则。
after.en: Split, apply, join. Neither part opens a box: they are the “and” gate’s truth table turned into rules.

brief.zh: 已知「下雨 → 地湿」「地湿 → 路滑」「下雨」，证出「路滑」。
brief.en: Given “it rains → the ground is wet”, “the ground is wet → the road is slippery” and “it rains”, prove “the road is slippery”.

hint.zh: 第一块套用给出「地湿」，它能接进第二块套用。
hint.en: The first Apply gives “the ground is wet”, which can go into a second Apply.

t.zh: 地基的第一块元件是套用：一个输入口接一句「如果…，那么…」，另一个接它的前一半，输出它的后一半。一句「如果…那么…」就像一台机器，套用就是把前一半喂给它。
t.en: The foundation’s first part is Apply: one input takes an “if …, then …”, the other its “if” part, and out comes its “then” part. An “if … then …” is like a machine, and Apply feeds it its “if” part.

t.zh: 「如果…，那么…」写成 →：「下雨 → 地湿」就是「如果下雨，那么地湿」。
t.en: “If …, then …” is written →: “it rains → the ground is wet” is “if it rains, then the ground is wet”.

after.zh: 套用只认形状，不管讲的是什么。推出来的「地湿」又当了下一步的输入。
after.en: Apply looks only at shape, never at what it is about. The “the ground is wet” it proved became the next step’s input.

brief.zh: 已知「今天是周六 → (下雨 → 我休息)」，证出「今天是周六 ∧ 下雨 → 我休息」。
brief.en: Given “today is Saturday → (it rains → I rest)”, prove “today is Saturday ∧ it rains → I rest”.

hint.zh: 框元件上的「假设」选「今天是周六 ∧ 下雨」。
hint.en: On the box, set “Assume” to “today is Saturday ∧ it rains”.

hint.zh: 在框里先把假设拆开，再放两块套用：第一张已知先套用到「今天是周六」，结果再套用到「下雨」，接到框的「结论」。
hint.en: In the box, split the assumption first, then put two Applies: apply the given to “today is Saturday”, then the result to “it rains”, and wire that to the box’s “Conclusion”.

t.zh: 地基的第二块元件是假设框。人会这样想：「假设今天是周六，而且下雨。今天是周六，那下雨我就休息；现在确实下雨，所以我休息。所以，如果今天是周六而且下雨，那么我休息。」
t.en: The foundation’s second part is the assumption box. A person thinks: “Suppose today is Saturday and it rains. It is Saturday, so if it rains I rest; it is raining, so I rest. So if today is Saturday and it rains, then I rest.”

t.zh: 框元件上选要假设的话，框左上角给出它；在框里证出的东西接到框右上角的「结论」，框外就得到「如果 假设，那么 结论」。点一下框里，新放的元件就落在框里。
t.en: Choose on the box what to assume, and its top left gives it; wire what you prove inside to “Conclusion” at its top right, and outside you get “if the assumption, then the conclusion”. Click inside the box and new parts land there.

t.zh: 套用用掉一句「如果…那么…」，框造出一句「如果…那么…」：地基就是这一对。
t.en: Apply uses an “if … then …” up, the box makes one: the foundation is this pair.

after.zh: 一个框、两次套用。真实的证明器 Lean 的内核也是从这一对开始的：框是 λ，套用是函数应用。
after.en: One box and two Applies. The kernel of Lean, a real prover, starts from this pair too: the box is λ, Apply is function application.

brief.zh: 已知「我坐公交 ∨ 我骑车」「我坐公交 → 我迟到了」「我骑车 → 我准时到」，证出「我迟到了 ∨ 我准时到」。
brief.en: Given “I take the bus ∨ I cycle”, “I take the bus → I am late” and “I cycle → I arrive on time”, prove “I am late ∨ I arrive on time”.

hint.zh: 「情况一」假设「我坐公交」，「情况二」假设「我骑车」；两个框都要证出「我迟到了 ∨ 我准时到」：先套用，再用补充补上另一边。
hint.en: Case one assumes “I take the bus”, case two “I cycle”; both boxes must prove “I am late ∨ I arrive on time”: apply first, then Add alternative for the other side.

t.zh: <level-ref to="or"></level-ref>里说过：光有一句 ∨，不知道是哪一边。现在有了框，就能每一边都假设一次。
t.en: <level-ref to="or"></level-ref> said an ∨ alone does not tell which side holds. With boxes, assume each side in turn.

t.zh: 分情况是一块有两个框的元件：接进「左边 ∨ 右边」，「情况一」假设左边，「情况二」假设右边；两个框证出同一句话，外面就得到它。
t.en: Case by case is a part with two boxes: wire in “left ∨ right”; case one assumes the left, case two the right; when both prove the same sentence, outside you get it.

after.zh: 不知道是哪一种，就每一种都证一遍。∧、∨ 的规则都不是框和套用造出来的：它们和框、套用一样，是证明器的基础元件。
after.en: Not knowing which, prove it for each. The rules of ∧ and ∨ are not built from the box and Apply: like them, they are the prover’s primitive parts.

brief.zh: 已知「下雨 → 地湿」和「地湿 → 路滑」，证出「下雨 → 路滑」。
brief.en: Given “it rains → the ground is wet” and “the ground is wet → the road is slippery”, prove “it rains → the road is slippery”.

hint.zh: 目标是一句「如果下雨，那么…」：假设「下雨」，看能套用出什么。
hint.en: The goal is “if it rains, then …”: assume “it rains” and see what Apply gets you.

t.zh: 两段「如果…那么…」首尾相接。要证一句「如果…那么…」，先假设它的前一半。
t.en: Two “if … then …”s meet end to end. To prove an “if … then …”, assume its first half.

after.zh: 要证「如果…那么…」，就假设它的前一半。下一个专题会拿掉框，看同一件事要费多少力气。
after.en: To prove an “if … then …”, assume its first half. The topic that follows takes the box away to see what the same thing costs.

brief.zh: 已知「下雨」为真，证出「下雨」为真。
brief.en: Given that “it rains” is true, prove that “it rains” is true.

hint.zh: 从「已知」元件右边的圆点，连到「目标」元件左边的圆点。
hint.en: Wire the dot on the right of the “Given” part to the dot on the left of the “Goal” part.

t.zh: 这台证明器的地基只有两块元件，后面的一切都要在它们上面搭出来。先看板子：左边的元件是已知，右边是目标，一根线的意思是「这句话已经证明为真」。
t.en: This prover’s foundation is two parts, and everything else is built on them. First the board: the parts on the left are given, the one on the right is the goal, and a wire means “this sentence has been proved true”.

t.zh: 板子下面是几组测试，每组讲一件不同的事；同一块电路要在每一组上都证得出。
t.en: Under the board are a few tests, each about something different; one circuit must prove every one of them.

after.zh: 已知为真的话，本身就是一个证明。
after.en: A given is already a proof of itself.

brief.zh: 没有任何已知，证出「下雨 → (刮风 → 下雨)」。
brief.en: With nothing given, prove “it rains → (it is windy → it rains)”.

hint.zh: 两个 →，两个框：外面的框假设「下雨」，里面的框假设「刮风」。里面要的结论，外面已经假设了。
hint.en: Two →s, two boxes: the outer one assumes “it rains”, the inner one “it is windy”. What the inner box must conclude, the outer one has assumed.

t.zh: 已经成立的事，加上什么条件都还成立。这句话叫 K；只有公理、没有框的证明器，只能把它当作不用证的出发点。
t.en: What holds still holds under any extra condition. This sentence is called K; a prover with axioms and no box can only take it as a starting point that needs no proof.

t.zh: 有了框，它可以证出来。框里可以再放框，里面的框看得见外面框的假设。
t.en: With boxes it can be proved. A box can sit inside a box, and the inner one sees the outer one’s assumption.

after.zh: 一次套用都没用。证出来以后，这块电路是元件 K：元件上选两句话，它直接给出「如果 第一句，那么（如果 第二句，那么 第一句）」。
after.en: Not one Apply. Proved, this circuit becomes the part K: choose two sentences on its part and it gives “if the first, then (if the second, then the first)” at once.

brief.zh: 已知「我骑车」和「我骑车 → 我准时到」，证出「我迟到了 ∨ 我准时到」。
brief.en: Given “I cycle” and “I cycle → I arrive on time”, prove “I am late ∨ I arrive on time”.

hint.zh: 套用得到「我准时到」，再用补充把它放到右边，左边选「我迟到了」。
hint.en: Apply to get “I arrive on time”, then use Add alternative to put it on the right, with “I am late” on the left.

t.zh: 「或」门：两边至少一个真，就输出真。「…或…」写成 ∨。
t.en: The “or” gate: true when at least one side is. “… or …” is written ∨.

t.zh: 补充：证出其中一边，便可补上另一句，得到「或者」命题。在元件上选另一句和它的位置。
t.en: Add alternative: once one side is proved, add another statement to form an “or”. Choose the other statement and its position on the part.

after.zh: 知道一边，就知道「这边 ∨ 随便哪边」。反过来不行：光有一句 ∨，不知道是哪一边成立，要用掉它，得等到有了框。
after.en: Knowing one side, you know “this ∨ anything”. Not the other way round: an ∨ alone does not say which side holds, and using one up waits until there are boxes.

brief.zh: 没有任何已知，证出「(下雨 → (刮风 → 地湿)) → ((下雨 → 刮风) → (下雨 → 地湿))」。
brief.en: With nothing given, prove “(it rains → (it is windy → the ground is wet)) → ((it rains → it is windy) → (it rains → the ground is wet))”.

hint.zh: 数一数最外层的 →：三个框，一个套一个，依次假设三个「如果」的部分。
hint.en: Count the outermost →s: three boxes, one inside the next, assuming the three “if” parts in turn.

hint.zh: 最里面有了「下雨」，把两句外层假设各套用一次，再把结果互相套用。
hint.en: With “it rains” innermost, apply each outer assumption to it once, then apply the results to each other.

t.zh: 这句话叫 S，和 K 一起，是只有公理的证明器的全部出发点。它说的是：在同一个条件「下雨」下，也能套用。读出来就是证明：三层假设，三次套用。
t.en: This sentence is called S; with K it is everything a prover with only axioms starts from. It says: under one condition, “it rains”, Apply still works. Read it aloud and you have the proof: three assumptions, three Applies.

after.zh: 现在 K 和 S 都是你证出来的元件，不是规定。
after.en: K and S are now parts you proved, not rules you were handed.

brief.zh: 不用假设框，证出<level-ref to="chain"></level-ref>的「下雨 → 路滑」。
brief.en: Without the assumption box, prove the “it rains → the road is slippery” of <level-ref to="chain"></level-ref>.

hint.zh: 框里的第二次套用是在条件「下雨」下做的：这正是 S 的事。S 的三句选「下雨」「地湿」「路滑」。
hint.en: The box’s second Apply happens under the condition “it rains”: that is S’s job. Choose “it rains”, “the ground is wet”, “the road is slippery” on S.

hint.zh: S 要「下雨 → (地湿 → 路滑)」：用 K 给「地湿 → 路滑」加上条件「下雨」。
hint.en: S wants “it rains → (the ground is wet → the road is slippery)”: let K put the condition “it rains” on “the ground is wet → the road is slippery”.

t.zh: <level-ref to="chain"></level-ref>里，框假设「下雨」，框里做了两次套用。把框拿掉，每一步都要改写：框里用到的已知，用 K 带上条件「下雨」；框里的套用，在条件下做，用 S。
t.en: In <level-ref to="chain"></level-ref> the box assumed “it rains” and did two Applies inside. Take the box away and each step is rewritten: a given used inside gets the condition “it rains” from K; an Apply inside happens under the condition, with S.

after.zh: 这个改写有固定的做法，任何一个框都能这样换成 K、S 和套用（演绎定理）。所以框不增加能证的东西，只是让证明好写得多：这就是证明器把框放进地基、把 K 和 S 降成元件的原因。
after.en: The rewrite follows a fixed recipe, and any box can be traded for K, S and Apply this way (the deduction theorem). So the box adds nothing provable; it only makes proofs far easier to write. That is why the prover puts the box in its foundation and K and S among its parts.

brief.zh: 不用假设框，由「下雨」证出「刮风 → 下雨」。
brief.en: Without the assumption box, prove “it is windy → it rains” from “it rains”.

hint.zh: K 的元件上第一句选「下雨」、第二句选「刮风」，再把它套用到已知上。
hint.en: Choose “it rains” and “it is windy” on K’s part, then apply it to the given.

t.zh: 这个专题把框拿走，只剩套用和你证出的 K、S。早期的证明器（希尔伯特系统）就是这样：只有一条规则和几条公理。
t.en: This topic takes the box away, leaving Apply and the K and S you proved. Early provers (Hilbert systems) were like this: one rule and a few axioms.

t.zh: 要给一句话加条件，框做不了，就得找一句现成的「如果…那么…」来套用。
t.en: To put a condition on a sentence without a box, find a ready-made “if … then …” to apply.

after.zh: 有框时一个框，没有框要 K 加一次套用。
after.en: One box with a box; without it, K and an Apply.

brief.zh: 不用假设框，什么已知都没有，证出「下雨 → 下雨」。
brief.en: Without the assumption box and with nothing given, prove “it rains → it rains”.

hint.zh: S 的三句选「下雨」「下雨 → 下雨」「下雨」。它要的两句都能用 K 造。
hint.en: Choose “it rains”, “it rains → it rains”, “it rains” on S. Both sentences it then needs can be made with K.

hint.zh: 一块 K（「下雨」「下雨 → 下雨」）接 S 之后的第一次套用；另一块 K（两句都是「下雨」）接第二次。
hint.en: One K (“it rains”, “it rains → it rains”) into the first Apply after S; another K (both “it rains”) into the second.

t.zh: 有框的话，这是一个空框：假设「下雨」，直接把假设接到结论。没有框，只能从 K 和 S 拼。S 的第二句选什么，是这一关的关键。
t.en: With a box this is an empty box: assume “it rains” and wire the assumption straight to the conclusion. Without one, it has to be pieced together from K and S, and the key is S’s second sentence.

after.zh: 一句一眼就对的话，没有框也得用 K 和 S 拼出来。
after.en: Even a plainly true sentence has to be pieced together from K and S without a box.

body.zh: 这一页试做《证明完毕》的一种新路线：证明器的地基只有套用和假设框，公理 K、S 是用框证出来的元件。它和正式关卡分开存档，互不影响。
body.en: This page tries out a new route for Q.E.D.: the prover’s foundation is just Apply and the assumption box, and the axioms K and S are parts proved with boxes. Its saves are separate from the main levels’.

body.zh: 套用用掉一句「如果…那么…」，假设框造出一句。真实的证明器 Lean 的内核也从这一对开始：框是 λ 抽象，套用是函数应用。证明器只检查这两块元件用得对不对，其余的元件都是证出来的。
body.en: Apply uses an “if … then …” up; the assumption box makes one. The kernel of Lean, a real prover, starts from this pair too: the box is λ-abstraction, Apply is function application. The prover checks only that these two are used right; every other part is proved.
